messages.subject: Error in data$longitude
parts:
Hi,
I am getting this error when trying to load it as.telemetry:

library(ctmm)
harpy<-as.telemetry("Harpy_MB.csv")

Error in data$longitude * (2 * pi/360) : 
  non-numeric argument to binary operator

Any idea about this? I am using the same file that I download from movebank.

Best,
Adrian
